terms.gloss: a rank, a degree, a step
evidence: Cic. Lael. 12: ex tam altō dignitātis gradū (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically a step in rank or standing of any kind, chiefly civil: per omnēs honōrum gradūs (Cic. Cat. 1.28, Lewis & Short).

evidence: Caes. BG 6.40: centuriōnēs ad superiōrēs ōrdinēs trādūcere (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The army’s own word for a centurion’s grade: to promote a centurion is to move him to a higher ōrdō.

phrases.english: to promote to a higher rank

sources: Lewis & Short: gradus · Lewis & Short: ordo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 187.
